description: This Dart file defines the AttendanceDatabaseSource class, which provides a unified data access layer for attendance-related operations in a Flutter application. It supports both remote API interactions and local database fallback mechanisms, handling login, attendance marking, and retrieving daily and weekly reports.

classes.name: AttendanceDatabaseSource
classes.description: A singleton class providing methods for login, attendance marking, and report retrieval with remote API fallback and local database support.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login via remote API or local fallback, returning user info and token.

methods.name: markAttendance
methods.description: Marks attendance for the current timestamp remotely or locally, returning status info.

methods.name: getDaily
methods.description: Retrieves daily attendance report for a given date, via remote API or local database.

methods.name: getWeekly
methods.description: Retrieves weekly attendance report between start and end dates, via remote API or local database.
